environment.description: Same Tomcat application deployed behind AWS ALB. RDS PostgreSQL 14.3 with identical schema. The database connection uses a role 'app_ro_scoped' configured with PostgreSQL statement-level permissions: the role has been granted EXECUTE on a specific SECURITY DEFINER function 'fn_get_account(text)' only, with no direct SELECT on base tables. The JNDI DataSource connects as 'app_ro_scoped'. Additionally, the pg_hba.conf on the RDS instance (via custom parameter group 'pg-hardened-14') sets 'statement_timeout=2000' and 'plan_cache_mode=force_generic_plan'. The RDS instance has 'log_min_duration_statement=0' and the custom parameter group includes 'session_preload_libraries=pg_stat_statements' with pg_stat_statements.track='all'. The role 'app_ro_scoped' has attribute NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE with a CONNECTION LIMIT 20.

config.role_grants: EXECUTE ON FUNCTION fn_get_account(text) only; NO direct table access
